units.title: 国朝·君恕则臣忠，共济明良之会；国泰则民乐，当推祸福之原；国之治乱兴衰，卦理推详剖决（总论）

rule.yi: 占国家的兴衰，是把整个卦当作国运来读。国家有始有终，必有兴有废；国君宽厚，臣子就忠心；国家太平，百姓就安乐；这些祸福的来由，都可以用卦理推到根上、剖开判决。哪一爻代表什么，见下一条。
rule.en: A question about the fortunes of a state reads the whole hexagram as the fortune of the realm. A state has a beginning and an end and must rise and fall; when the ruler is forgiving the ministers are loyal, and when the state is at peace the people are happy; the source of such blessings and disasters can be traced and decided by the principles of the hexagram. Which line stands for what is in the next rule.

zh: 君恕则臣忠，共济明良之会；
国泰则民乐，当推祸福之原。
虽天地尚知其始终，况国家岂能无兴废？
yi: 国君宽恕体恤，臣子就忠心，君臣共同成就明君与良臣相遇的盛会；
国家太平，百姓就安乐，要推究的就是祸福产生的根源。
连天地尚且知道有它的开始和终结，何况一个国家，怎么可能没有兴盛和衰亡？
en: When the ruler is forgiving the ministers are loyal, and together they bring about the meeting of a bright ruler and good ministers;
when the state is at peace the people are happy, and what is to be traced is the source of disaster and fortune.
Even heaven and earth are known to have a beginning and an end, so how could a state be without rise and fall?

zh: 国之治乱兴衰，卦理推详剖决。
yi: 国家是治是乱、是兴是衰，都可以用卦理详细推究、剖析判断。
en: Whether a state is in order or in disorder, rising or declining, can be examined in detail and decided by the principles of the hexagram.

note.yi: 国朝章从这里开头、到这里收尾，中间二十多联都是拿具体的历史人物来讲卦象，用法见下面各条。
note.en: The chapter on the state opens and closes with these lines; the twenty-odd couplets between them use particular historical figures to teach the images, as the entries that follow show.

units.title: 国朝·本宫旺相，周文王创八百年之基；大象休囚，秦始皇遗二世主之祸（旧注：本宫为国爻，太岁为君、岁合为后、月建为臣、日建为东宫、子孙为黎庶、父爻为国；本宫旺相国祚长，休囚而大象又凶则速亡）

rule.yi: 占国运，先分派各爻：本宫是国爻，太岁是君，和太岁相合的是后，月建是臣，日建是东宫（太子），子孙是百姓，父爻是国家。开国时占得本宫旺相，国运绵长，像周文王那样子孙享国八百年；本宫休囚、整个卦象又凶，国运短促，像秦始皇那样到二世就亡国。
rule.en: To ask about the fortune of a state, first assign the lines: the home palace is the line of the state, Tai Sui is the ruler, the branch combining with Tai Sui is the empress, the Month is the minister, the Day is the Eastern Palace (the crown prince), Output is the common people and Resource is the realm. If a state is being founded and the home palace comes out thriving or strong, its fortune is long, as with King Wen of Zhou, whose descendants held the realm for eight hundred years; if the home palace is resting or trapped and the whole image is also bad, its fortune is short, as with the First Emperor of Qin, whose state was lost with the second reign.

zh: 本宫旺相，周文王创八百年之基；
大象休囚，秦始皇遗二世主之祸。
yi: 本宫旺相，就像周文王创下了八百年的基业；
整个卦象休囚，就像秦始皇留下了二世皇帝覆亡的祸患。
en: If the home palace is thriving or strong, it is like King Wen of Zhou founding a base of eight hundred years;
if the whole image is resting or trapped, it is like the First Emperor of Qin leaving behind the disaster of the Second Emperor.

zh: 本宫为国爻。
以太岁为君爻，岁合为后爻；
月建为臣爻，日建为东宫；
子孙为黎庶，父爻为国。
若建国时，卜得本宫旺相，如周文王，子孙享国八百年之久也。
史记周武王定鼎于洛，卜云：传位三十，历年七百。
后至赧王亡，共算八百余年。
故曰：周过其历也。
若本宫休囚，大象又凶，则如秦始皇，二世亡国。
yi: 本宫是代表国家的爻。
拿太岁当君主的爻，和太岁相合的当皇后的爻；
月建当臣子的爻，日建当东宫（太子）；
子孙当百姓，父爻当国家。
如果是开国之时占卜，占得本宫旺相，就像周文王那样，子孙享有国运长达八百年。
《史记》记载周武王在洛邑定都，占卜的结果是：传位三十代，经历七百年。
后来到周赧王时灭亡，一共算下来有八百多年。
所以说：周朝超过了卜到的年数。
如果本宫休囚，整个卦象又凶，就像秦始皇那样，到二世就亡国。
en: The home palace is the line of the state.
Take Tai Sui as the ruler's line and the branch that combines with Tai Sui as the empress's line;
the Month as the ministers' line and the Day as the Eastern Palace (the crown prince);
Output as the common people and Resource as the realm.

If the divination is made when a state is being founded and the home palace comes out thriving or strong, it is like King Wen of Zhou, whose descendants enjoyed the realm for as long as eight hundred years.
The Records of the Grand Historian say that when King Wu of Zhou fixed the tripods at Luo, the divination read: thirty successions, seven hundred years.
Later the dynasty perished with King Nan, and in all it came to more than eight hundred years.
Hence it is said: Zhou went beyond its reckoned span.
If the home palace is resting or trapped and the whole image is also bad, it is like the First Emperor of Qin, whose state was lost with the second reign.

zh: 如臣卜以本宫为国朝，以太岁为君爻，岁合为后爻，月建为臣爻，日建为东宫，子孙为黎庶，父爻为国。
卜得本宫旺相，如周文王子孙享国八百年之久；
若本宫休囚，大象又凶，则如秦始皇二世亡国。
yi: 臣子占卜时，以本宫为国朝，以太岁为君爻，岁合为后爻，月建为臣爻，日建为东宫，子孙为百姓，父爻为国家。
占得本宫旺相，就像周文王的子孙享有国运八百年之久；
如果本宫休囚，整个卦象又凶，就像秦始皇到二世就亡国。
en: When a minister casts, take the home palace as the court of the state, Tai Sui as the ruler's line, the branch combining with Tai Sui as the empress's line, the Month as the ministers' line, the Day as the Eastern Palace, Output as the common people and Resource as the realm.
If the home palace comes out thriving or strong, it is like the descendants of King Wen of Zhou holding the realm for as long as eight hundred years;
if the home palace is resting or trapped and the whole image is also bad, it is like the First Emperor of Qin, whose state was lost with the second reign.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗把这段分派写成「如臣卜」（臣子占国朝），并在后面「年伤弱世」一联说「以下指言国君自卜」，把这一章分成臣子占国运和国君自占两种占法；卜筮大全的旧注没有这样标明。
note.en: The Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes this assignment as what applies 'when a minister casts', and at the couplet 'the year injures a weak Self' it says 'what follows speaks of the ruler casting for himself', so that it divides the chapter into a minister asking about the realm and the ruler asking about himself; the old commentary in the Bu Shi Da Quan does not mark this.

units.title: 国朝·九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主；四爻值福，必多忠义之臣（旧注：五爻为君位，逢阳象又遇青龙财福是仁明之君；四爻为臣位，子孙旺相克世是敢谏之臣，兄鬼生合世爻是阿谀佞臣）

rule.yi: 第五爻是君位：逢到阳象，又遇到青龙、妻财、子孙，是仁慈英明的君主；世爻临阳象、带吉神也一样。第四爻是臣位：子孙旺相、克世爻，是敢于直言进谏的臣子；兄弟、官鬼生合世爻，是阿谀奉承的佞臣。
rule.en: The fifth line is the ruler's seat: if it meets a yang image and also meets the Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output, the ruler is benevolent and enlightened, and so it is if the Self sits in a yang image with auspicious spirits. The fourth line is the ministers' seat: if Output is thriving or strong and controls the Self, the minister dares to remonstrate plainly; if a Peer or Pressure line generates or combines with the Self, he is a flattering and treacherous minister.

zh: 九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主；
四爻值福，必多忠义之臣。
yi: 九五（第五爻）逢到阳，会遇到仁慈英明的君主；
第四爻逢到福神，必定有很多忠义的臣子。
en: If the fifth line meets yang, one will meet a benevolent and enlightened ruler;
if the fourth line meets the lucky star of Output, there will surely be many loyal and righteous ministers.

zh: 五爻为君位。
若逢阳象，更遇青龙财福，必是仁明之君。
世临阳象，带吉神亦然。
四爻为臣位，若子孙旺相克世，乃敢谏直臣。
若兄鬼生合世爻，乃阿谀佞臣也。
yi: 第五爻是君主的位置。
如果逢到阳象，又遇到青龙、妻财、福神，必定是仁慈英明的君主。
世爻临在阳象上、带着吉神，也是这样。
第四爻是臣子的位置，如果子孙旺相、克世爻，就是敢于直言进谏的臣子。
如果兄弟、官鬼生合世爻，就是阿谀奉承的奸佞臣子。
en: The fifth line is the ruler's seat.
If it meets a yang image and further meets the Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output, the ruler is surely benevolent and enlightened.
If the Self sits in a yang image and carries auspicious spirits, it is the same.
The fourth line is the ministers' seat; if Output is thriving or strong and controls the Self, he is a minister who dares to remonstrate plainly.
If a Peer or Pressure line generates or combines with the Self, he is a flattering and treacherous minister.

zh: 五爻为君位，逢阳象遇青龙财福，是仁明之君。
四爻为臣位，临旺福乃敢谏直臣，临兄鬼乃阿谀佞臣也。
yi: 第五爻是君主的位置，逢到阳象又遇到青龙、妻财、福神，是仁慈英明的君主。
第四爻是臣子的位置，逢到旺相的福神是敢于直言进谏的臣子，逢到兄弟、官鬼就是阿谀奉承的奸佞臣子。
en: The fifth line is the ruler's seat; when it meets a yang image and meets the Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output, he is a benevolent and enlightened ruler.

The fourth line is the ministers' seat; when it meets a thriving Output line he is a minister who dares to remonstrate plainly, and when it meets a Peer or Pressure line he is a flattering and treacherous minister.

note.yi: 条件有出入：旧注要子孙旺相并且克世爻、兄鬼要生合世爻；卜筮正宗只说第四爻「临旺福」「临兄鬼」，没有说克世或生合世爻。
note.en: The conditions differ: the old commentary requires Output to be thriving and to control the Self, and the Peer or Pressure line to generate or combine with the Self; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only that the fourth line 'meets a thriving Output' or 'meets Peer or Pressure', and does not mention controlling or combining with the Self.

units.title: 国朝·岁克衰宫，玉树后庭花欲谢（旧注：本宫衰死又遇太岁所克，其年国有乱亡之兆；陈后主宫中酣歌不已，后为隋所灭）

rule.yi: 本宫衰弱死绝，又被太岁克，这一年国家有动乱灭亡的征兆，就像陈后主在宫里日夜歌舞饮宴，后来被隋朝灭掉。
rule.en: If the home palace is weak or dead and is also controlled by Tai Sui, the state shows signs of disorder and ruin that year, like the last ruler of Chen, who gave himself to songs and revels in the palace and was later destroyed by Sui.

zh: 岁克衰宫，玉树后庭花欲谢；
yi: 太岁克制衰弱的本宫，就像《玉树后庭花》将要凋谢；
en: If Tai Sui controls a weak home palace, it is as if 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court' were about to fade;

zh: 本宫衰死，更遇太岁所克，其年国有乱亡之兆。
昔陈将亡，后主使诸妃嫔，及女乐与侠客，共赋诗，互相赠答。
采其尤艳丽者，被以新声；
选宫女千余，习而歌之，分部迭奏。
其曲有玉树后庭花，临春乐等，大略皆美诸嫔妃之容色。
君臣酣歌，自夕达旦，以此为常。
后为隋所灭。
故曰：玉树后庭花欲谢也。
yi: 本宫衰弱死绝，又遇到太岁来克，这一年国家有动乱灭亡的征兆。
从前陈朝将要灭亡的时候，陈后主让众妃嫔，连同歌女乐伎和游侠宾客，一起作诗，互相赠答。
挑出其中最艳丽的诗句，配上新曲；
选了一千多名宫女，学着歌唱，分成几部轮流演奏。
那些曲子有《玉树后庭花》《临春乐》等，大致都是赞美各位妃嫔的容貌姿色。
君臣尽兴唱歌饮酒，从晚上到天亮，一直这样成了常事。
后来陈被隋灭掉了。
所以说：《玉树后庭花》将要凋谢了。
en: If the home palace is weak or dead and meets control from Tai Sui, the state shows signs of disorder and ruin that year.
Long ago, when Chen was about to fall, its last ruler had his consorts, together with the singing women and the wandering gallant guests, compose poems together and exchange them with one another.
They picked the most gorgeous of the verses and set them to new tunes;
they chose over a thousand palace women to learn and sing them, and the groups performed in turn.
Among the pieces were 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court' and 'Linchun Le', which in the main all praised the beauty of the consorts.
Ruler and ministers sang and drank to their heart's content from evening until dawn, and made it a habit.
Later Chen was destroyed by Sui.
That is why it says: 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court' is about to fade.

zh: 本宫衰弱遇太岁克，国有乱亡之兆。
陈后主选宫女，曲有“玉树后庭花”，君臣酣歌，旦夕为常，后为隋所灭。
yi: 本宫衰弱，遇到太岁来克，国家有动乱灭亡的征兆。
陈后主挑选宫女，曲子里有《玉树后庭花》，君臣尽兴歌唱，从早到晚成了常事，后来被隋灭掉。
en: If the home palace is weak and meets control from Tai Sui, the state shows signs of disorder and ruin.

The last ruler of Chen picked palace women, and among their pieces was 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court'; ruler and ministers sang to their heart's content from morning to night as a matter of course, and Chen was later destroyed by Sui.

units.title: 国朝·年伤弱世，鼎湖龙去不多时（旧注：太岁刑冲克害世爻主国君疾病或内难将作，世爻又衰弱必有君崩之忧）

rule.yi: 国君自己占卜：太岁来刑、冲、克、害世爻，主国君生病，或者宫廷内部将有祸乱；如果世爻同时又衰弱，就要担心国君驾崩。
rule.en: When the ruler casts for himself: if Tai Sui punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, the ruler will be ill or trouble will break out within the court; if the Self is also weak, there is cause to fear the ruler's death.

zh: 年伤弱世，鼎湖龙去不多时。
yi: 太岁伤克衰弱的世爻，国君像黄帝在鼎湖乘龙升天一样，离世就在不久之后。
en: If the year injures a weak Self, the dragon departs from Ding Lake before long.

zh: 太岁刑冲克害世爻，主国君疾病，或内难将作。
若克世爻，而世爻衰弱，必有君崩之忧。
史记曰：黄帝乘龙上天。
故凡帝崩曰升遐，讳言死也。
今日鼎湖龙去，言其不久而崩也。
yi: 太岁刑、冲、克、害世爻，主国君有疾病，或者内部的祸乱将要发作。
如果克的是世爻，而世爻又衰弱，必定有国君驾崩的忧虑。
《史记》说：黄帝乘龙升天。
所以凡是皇帝去世都叫「升遐」，是避讳说死。
现在说「鼎湖龙去」，是说他不久就要驾崩。
en: If Tai Sui punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, it means illness of the ruler, or internal troubles about to break out.
If it controls the Self and the Self is weak, there is surely cause to fear the ruler's death.
The Records of the Grand Historian says: the Yellow Emperor rose to heaven on a dragon.
So whenever an emperor dies it is called 'ascending far away', which avoids the word death.
Here 'the dragon leaves Ding Lake' says that he will die before long.

zh: 以下指言国君自卜。
如太岁刑冲克害世爻，主疾病或内难将作。
yi: 以下是指国君自己占卜。
例如太岁刑、冲、克、害世爻，主有疾病，或者内部的祸难将要发作。
en: What follows speaks of the ruler casting for himself.
For example, if Tai Sui punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, it means illness or internal troubles about to break out.

note.yi: 「以下指言国君自卜」是卜筮正宗加的一句话，旧注里没有；按它的说法，从这一联起到「应带咸池」都是国君自占。
note.en: The sentence 'what follows speaks of the ruler casting for himself' is the Bu Shi Zheng Zong's own; the old commentary has no such line. On its reading, everything from this couplet through 'the Other carrying Xianchi' is the ruler's own cast.

units.title: 国朝·世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国（旧注：世临沐浴，或财爻应爻带沐浴动克合世，必是国君好色；如夫差恋西施拒子胥之谏，后为越王勾践所灭）

rule.yi: 世爻落在沐浴上，或者妻财爻、应爻带着沐浴发动、来克合世爻，多半是国君好色，就像夫差迷恋西施、拒不听伍子胥的劝谏，后来被越王勾践灭掉。
rule.en: If the Self sits on Bathing, or the Wealth line or the Other line carries Bathing, moves, and controls or combines with the Self, the ruler is surely fond of women, like Fuchai who doted on Xishi, refused the remonstrance of Zixu, and was later destroyed by Goujian, King of Yue.

zh: 世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国；
yi: 世爻落在沐浴上、又合妻财，就像夫差迷恋西施而亡国；
en: If the Self sits on Bathing and combines with the Wealth line, it is like Fuchai who doted on Xishi and lost his state;

zh: 世临沐浴，或财爻、应爻带沐浴动，克合世爻，必是国君好色。
如夫差恋西施美，拒子胥谏，后为越王勾践所灭。
yi: 世爻落在沐浴上，或者财爻、应爻带着沐浴发动，来克、合世爻，必定是国君好色。
就像夫差迷恋西施的美貌，拒绝伍子胥的劝谏，后来被越王勾践灭掉。
en: If the Self sits on Bathing, or the Wealth line or the Other line carries Bathing and moves to control or combine with the Self, the ruler is surely fond of women.
It is like Fuchai who doted on the beauty of Xishi, rejected the remonstrance of Zixu, and was later destroyed by Goujian, King of Yue.

zh: 皆指言帝自卜也。
如世临沐浴合财爻、应爻或沐浴动克合世，必是好色，如夫差恋西施之美，为越所灭。
yi: （以上）都是指国君自己占卜。
例如世爻落在沐浴上，合财爻、应爻，或者沐浴发动来克合世爻，必定是好色，就像夫差迷恋西施的美貌，被越灭掉。
en: All of this speaks of the ruler casting for himself.

For example, if the Self sits on Bathing and combines with the Wealth line or the Other line, or Bathing moves to control or combine with the Self, he is surely fond of women, like Fuchai who doted on the beauty of Xishi and was destroyed by Yue.

units.title: 国朝·应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周（旧注：应爻为皇后，带咸池其后必淫，更居九五是后居尊位，如吕后临朝；再旺动刑冲克害世爻、世或空亡，则如武后废中宗革唐为周）

rule.yi: 应爻是皇后。应爻带咸池，皇后一定不检点；又落在第五爻，就是皇后居于至尊之位，像汉朝的吕后临朝称制；如果它再旺相发动、刑冲克害世爻，世爻又逢空亡，就像唐朝的武后废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐为周。
rule.en: The Other line is the empress. If it carries Xianchi, the empress is sure to be licentious; if it also sits in the fifth place, the empress holds the seat of honour, like Empress Lü of Han presiding at court and issuing edicts; if it is also thriving and moving, and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, while the Self may be Void, it is like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Emperor Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and turned the Tang mandate into Zhou.

zh: 应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周。
yi: 应爻带着咸池，又落在九五，就像武后改变了唐的国运、改唐为周。
en: If the Other line carries Xianchi and sits in the fifth place, it is like Empress Wu who changed the mandate of Tang and made it Zhou.

zh: 应乃皇后之位。
若带咸池，其后必淫。
更居九五，乃是后居尊位。
如汉吕后，临朝称制。
更有旺动，刑冲克害世爻，世或空亡，必如唐武后废中宗为庐陵王，革唐命为周。
yi: 应爻是皇后的位置。
如果带着咸池，那位皇后必定淫乱。
再落在九五，就是皇后居于至尊之位。
就像汉朝的吕后，临朝执政、代行皇帝的号令。
如果它再旺相发动，刑、冲、克、害世爻，世爻又落空亡，必定像唐朝的武后那样，废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐的国运为周。
en: The Other line is the empress's place.
If it carries Xianchi, the empress is sure to be licentious.
If it also sits in the fifth place, the empress holds the seat of honour.
It is like Empress Lü of Han, who presided at court and issued edicts in the ruler's place.

If it is also thriving and moving, and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, and the Self may be Void, it is surely like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Emperor Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and changed the Tang mandate into Zhou.

zh: 君自卜以应爻为皇后，若带咸池，其后必淫，更居九五尊位克世，如唐武后废中宗为庐陵王，革唐命为周。
yi: 国君自己占卜时，以应爻为皇后，如果带着咸池，那位皇后必定淫乱，再落在九五的尊位又来克世，就像唐朝的武后废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐的国运为周。
en: When the ruler casts for himself, take the Other line as the empress; if it carries Xianchi the empress is sure to be licentious, and if it also sits in the honoured seat of the fifth place and controls the Self, it is like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and changed the Tang mandate into Zhou.

note.yi: 两处条件不同：旧注要应爻再旺相发动、刑冲克害世爻，并说「世或空亡」；卜筮正宗只说应爻居九五尊位、克世，没有提世爻落空。
note.en: The conditions differ: the old commentary adds that the Other line is thriving and moving and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, and says 'the Self may be Void'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only that the Other line sits in the honoured fifth place and controls the Self, and does not mention the Self being Void.

units.title: 国朝·游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返（旧注：游魂卦主国君迁都游荡巡狩；再加凶杀克世，或世动入死墓空绝，则如虞舜南巡崩于苍梧之野）

rule.yi: 国君自占得游魂卦，是迁都、四处巡游的象，像周穆王巡游天下；如果再带凶煞克世，或世爻发动、变入死、墓、空、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的野外，一去不回。
rule.en: When the ruler casts for himself, a Wandering Soul hexagram is the image of moving the capital and touring the realm, like King Mu of Zhou who toured the whole land; if a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu, who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu, never to return.

zh: 游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返；
yi: 游魂卦遇到空，就像虞舜南巡一去不回；
en: If a Wandering Soul hexagram meets Void, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and never returned;

zh: 卦遇游魂，主国君迁都游荡巡狩之象。
如周穆王巡狩游行天下。
若加凶杀克世，或世动入死墓空绝，则如虞舜南巡，崩于苍梧之野。
yi: 卦遇到游魂，主国君迁都、四处游荡巡视的象。
就像周穆王巡视出游天下。
如果再加上凶煞来克世，或者世爻发动变入死、墓、空、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的原野上。
en: If the hexagram is a Wandering Soul hexagram, it is the image of the ruler moving the capital and wandering about on tours of inspection.
It is like King Mu of Zhou who toured the whole land.
If a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu.

zh: 卦遇游魂不宜迁都巡狩，若加凶煞克世，或世爻动化墓绝，如虞舜南巡崩于苍梧之野。
yi: 卦遇到游魂，不适合迁都、巡视；如果再加凶煞来克世，或者世爻发动变入墓、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的原野上。
en: If the hexagram is a Wandering Soul hexagram it is not fit to move the capital or go on a tour; if a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self line moves and turns into tomb or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu.

note.yi: 旧注把游魂卦读作「迁都游荡巡狩之象」，只是一个象；卜筮正宗读作「不宜迁都巡狩」，是一条忌讳。两处说法的轻重不完全一样。
note.en: The old commentary reads a Wandering Soul hexagram as 'the image of moving the capital, wandering and touring', which is only an image; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong reads it as 'not fit for moving the capital or touring', which is a prohibition. The weight is not quite the same.

units.title: 国朝·归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身（旧注：归魂卦遇凶神恶杀动克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘之野）

rule.yi: 国君自占得归魂卦，又遇凶神恶煞发动来克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇到海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘。
rule.en: When the ruler casts for himself, a Returning Soul hexagram that meets baleful spirits moving to control the Self or the Body is like the First Emperor of Qin, who sought immortals by the sea and died at Shaqiu after returning to his state.

zh: 归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身。
yi: 归魂卦带着凶煞，就像秦始皇回到国都途中丧了命。
en: If a Returning Soul hexagram carries a baleful spirit, it is like the First Emperor who returned to his state and lost his life.

zh: 若归魂卦，遇凶神恶杀，动克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘之野。
yi: 如果是归魂卦，遇到凶神恶煞发动来克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇在海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘的原野上。
en: If it is a Returning Soul hexagram and meets baleful spirits that move and control the Self or the Body, it is like the First Emperor who sought immortals by the sea and died in the wilds of Shaqiu after returning to his state.

zh: 若归魂卦遇动爻克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘。
yi: 如果是归魂卦，遇到动爻克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇在海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘。
en: If it is a Returning Soul hexagram and meets a moving line that controls the Self or the Body, it is like the First Emperor who sought immortals by the sea and died at Shaqiu after returning to his state.

note.yi: 旧注要「凶神恶杀」发动克世身；卜筮正宗只说「遇动爻克世身」，没有说凶神恶煞。「世身」按世爻与卦身两者读。
note.en: The old commentary requires baleful spirits moving to control the Self and Body; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only 'meets a moving line that controls the Self and Body', without baleful spirits. 'Self and Body' is read as the Self line and the Body together.

units.title: 国朝·子发逢空，张子房起归山之计（旧注：子孙为臣，逢空动或四爻臣位空动，更被世爻克害，是君欲害臣、臣欲避君，如张良托辟谷弃职从赤松子游）

rule.yi: 子孙是臣。子孙逢空发动，或者第四爻（臣位）落空而动、又被世爻克害，是国君想害臣子、臣子想躲开国君，就像张良借口辟谷、辞去官职，跟随赤松子出游。
rule.en: Output is the minister. If Output meets Void and moves, or the fourth line, the ministers' seat, is Void and moves and is also controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler wants to harm the minister and the minister wants to avoid the ruler, like Zhang Liang, who pleaded fasting from grain, gave up office and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

zh: 子发逢空，张子房起归山之计；
yi: 子孙发动逢到空，就像张子房起了退隐归山的打算；
en: If Output moves and meets Void, it is like Zhang Zifang forming the plan to retire to the hills;

zh: 子孙为臣。
若逢空动，或四爻臣位空动，更被世爻克害，必是君欲害臣，臣欲避君。
如汉张良，托为辟谷，弃职从赤松子游也。
yi: 子孙是臣子。
如果逢空发动，或者第四爻臣位空动，又被世爻克害，必定是国君想害臣子，臣子想躲开国君。
就像汉朝的张良，假托辟谷不食，放弃官职跟随赤松子出游。
en: Output is the minister.

If it meets Void and moves, or the fourth line, the ministers' seat, is Void and moves, and is also controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler surely wants to harm the minister and the minister wants to avoid the ruler.
It is like Zhang Liang of Han, who gave fasting from grain as his pretext, abandoned his post and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

zh: 他宫子孙为臣，若逢空动被世克害，必是君欲害臣，如汉张良弃职从赤松子游也。
yi: 别的宫的子孙是臣子，如果逢空发动、被世克害，必定是国君想害臣子，就像汉朝张良弃官跟随赤松子出游。
en: The Output of another palace is the minister; if it meets Void and moves and is controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler surely wants to harm the minister, like Zhang Liang of Han who gave up office and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

note.yi: 子孙有两种：本宫的子孙是太子（见「日辰拱扶子位」一联），别的宫的子孙是臣。卜筮正宗在这一联明说「他宫子孙为臣」；卜筮大全旧注这里只写「子孙为臣」，到「日辰拱扶子位」才分他宫与本宫。
note.en: Output comes in two kinds: the Output of the home palace is the crown prince (see the couplet 'the Day supports Output's place'), and the Output of another palace is the minister. The Bu Shi Zheng Zong says so outright here, 'the Output of another palace is the minister'; the old commentary in the Bu Shi Da Quan writes only 'Output is the minister' here and draws the line between another palace and the home palace at 'the Day supports Output's place'.

units.title: 国朝·将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤（旧注：将星看日支，临财子必忠良智勇之将，值官鬼白虎强悍，临父是老将、遇兄庸常；将星持鬼克世如曹操桓温篡位，被动爻克害如岳飞遇秦桧）

rule.yi: 将星按占卦那天的地支来找，例如寅、午、戌日占，午爻就是将星。将星临妻财、子孙，必是忠良有智勇的将领；值官鬼、白虎，是强悍的将领；临父母爻，是年老的将领；遇兄弟，不过是平庸的将领。将星持官鬼来克害世爻，就像曹操、桓温挟天子以令诸侯，往往篡位自立；将星被动爻或第四爻动来克害，就像岳飞遇到秦桧这样的权奸而被害死。
rule.en: Find the General star from the day branch: on a Yin, Wu or Xu day, the Wu line is the General star, and so on for the others. A General star on Wealth or Output means a loyal, able, wise and brave general; meeting Pressure or the White Tiger, a fierce and stubborn one; on Resource, an old general; meeting Peer, no more than a commonplace one. If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, it is like Cao Cao and Huan Wen, who held the emperor and gave orders to the lords and mostly ended by usurping the throne; if the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, or by a moving fourth line, it is like Yue Fei of Song, who was killed by the harm of the powerful and treacherous Qin Hui.

zh: 将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤。
yi: 将星被克害，就像岳武穆含着向天呼冤的冤屈。
en: If the General star is harmed, it is like Yue Wumu who bore a grievance he could only cry out to heaven.

zh: 将星，如寅午戌日卜，午爻为将星是。
余类推。
若将星临财子，必得忠良智勇之将。
将星值官鬼白虎，必强悍之将。
若临父，必老将；
遇兄，不过庸常之将。
若将星持鬼，克害世爻，必如曹操桓温，挟天子以令诸侯，多致篡位自立。
若将星被动爻克害，或被四爻动克，必如宋岳飞，遇秦桧权奸之害而死也。
yi: 将星，比如在寅、午、戌日占卜，午爻就是将星。
其余的依此类推。
如果将星临在妻财、子孙上，必定得到忠良而有智有勇的将领。
将星遇到官鬼、白虎，必定是强悍的将领。
如果临在父爻上，必定是年老的将领；
遇到兄弟，不过是平庸寻常的将领。
如果将星持着官鬼，克害世爻，必定像曹操、桓温那样，挟持天子来号令诸侯，多半导致篡位自立。
如果将星被动爻克害，或者被第四爻发动来克，必定像宋朝的岳飞，遇到秦桧这样的权奸迫害而死。
en: As for the General star, if the cast is made on a Yin, Wu or Xu day, the Wu line is the General star.
The rest follow by analogy.
If the General star is on Wealth or Output, one will surely get a loyal, good, wise and brave general.
If the General star meets Pressure or the White Tiger, he is surely a fierce and stubborn general.
If it is on Resource, he is surely an old general;
if it meets Peer, he is no more than a commonplace general.

If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, it is surely like Cao Cao and Huan Wen, who held the emperor to command the lords and mostly ended by usurping the throne and setting themselves up.

If the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, or controlled by a moving fourth line, it is surely like Yue Fei of Song, who was killed by the harm of the powerful and treacherous Qin Hui.

zh: 将星，寅午戌日卜，午爻为将星，其余类推。
若将星临财子，必得忠职智勇，值官鬼白虎，必强悍之将。
若将星持鬼克害世爻，恐有造谋之变；
若将星被动爻克害，如岳武穆遇秦桧之害也。
yi: 将星是这样找的：寅、午、戌日占卜，午爻就是将星，其余依此类推。
如果将星临在妻财、子孙上，必定得到尽忠职守、有智有勇的将领；遇到官鬼、白虎，必定是强悍的将领。
如果将星持着官鬼，克害世爻，恐怕会有图谋作乱的变故；
如果将星被动爻克害，就像岳武穆遇到秦桧的陷害。
en: As for the General star, on a Yin, Wu or Xu day the Wu line is the General star, and the rest follow by analogy.

If the General star is on Wealth or Output, one will surely get a general who is loyal to his duty, wise and brave; if it meets Pressure or the White Tiger, he is surely a fierce and stubborn general.
If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, there may be an upheaval of plotting and scheming;
if the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, it is like Yue Wumu meeting the harm of Qin Hui.

note.yi: 将星持鬼克世的结果，旧注举曹操、桓温挟天子篡位；卜筮正宗收成「恐有造谋之变」，没有举人名。被克害那一句，旧注还多一个「被四爻动克」。
note.en: For a General star holding Pressure and controlling the Self, the old commentary gives Cao Cao and Huan Wen holding the emperor and usurping; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong boils it down to 'there may be an upheaval of plotting' with no names. For the harmed General star, the old commentary adds 'or controlled by a moving fourth line'.

units.title: 国朝·应旺生合世爻，圣主得椒房之助（旧注：应爻为皇后，旺相生合世爻又临财福，皇后美貌智略、天性慈仁，能规君过、导君以善，如汉马后、宋宣仁）

rule.yi: 应爻是皇后。应爻旺相、生合世爻，又临妻财或子孙，皇后相貌美、有智谋、天性仁慈，能规劝国君的过失，引导国君向善，像汉朝的马皇后、宋朝的宣仁皇后。
rule.en: The Other line is the empress. If the Other line is thriving or strong, generates or combines with the Self, and sits on Wealth or Output, the empress is beautiful, wise and kind by nature, and can correct the ruler's faults and lead him to the good, like Empress Ma of Han and Empress Xuanren of Song.

zh: 应旺生合世爻，圣主得椒房之助；
yi: 应爻旺相、生合世爻，圣明的君主就能得到皇后的帮助；
en: If the Other line is thriving and generates or combines with the Self, the sage ruler gains the help of the Pepper Chamber (the empress's quarters);

zh: 应爻，皇后之位。
若应爻旺相，生合世爻，更临财福；
主皇后美貌智略，天性慈仁；
能规君过，导君以善。
如汉马后。
宋宜仁，称女中尧舜也。
后房用椒涂壁，以辟除邪气。
故曰椒房。
yi: 应爻是皇后的位置。
如果应爻旺相，生合世爻，又临在妻财、福神上；
主皇后容貌美丽、有智谋才略，天性慈爱仁厚；
能规劝国君的过失，引导国君做善事。
就像汉朝的马皇后。
宋朝的宣仁（这里原文作「宜仁」）皇后，被称作女中的尧舜。
皇后的居室用花椒涂在墙壁上，用来驱除邪气。
所以叫椒房。
en: The Other line is the empress's place.
If the Other line is thriving or strong, generates or combines with the Self, and sits on Wealth or Output;
it means the empress is beautiful, wise and capable, and kind and benevolent by nature;
she can correct the ruler's faults and lead him to the good.
Such was Empress Ma of Han.
Empress Xuanren of Song (written Yiren here) was called a Yao and Shun among women.
The empress's chambers had pepper plastered on the walls, to drive away evil influences.
Hence the name Pepper Chamber.

zh: 应为皇后，若旺相合世爻，更临财福，主后智略仁慈，导君以善，如汉马后、宋宣仁，为女中尧舜是也。
yi: 应爻是皇后，如果旺相、合世爻，又临妻财、福神，主皇后有智谋才略、仁慈，引导国君向善，像汉朝的马皇后、宋朝的宣仁皇后，就是女中的尧舜。
en: The Other line is the empress; if it is thriving or strong and combines with the Self, and further sits on Wealth or Output, the empress is wise, capable and kind and leads the ruler to the good, like Empress Ma of Han and Empress Xuanren of Song, who were the Yao and Shun among women.

note.yi: 宋朝那位皇后，卜筮大全的旧注写「宜仁」，卜筮正宗写「宣仁」；译文按「宣仁」读（宋朝被称作「女中尧舜」的宣仁太后）。
note.en: The old commentary in the Bu Shi Da Quan writes the Song empress as 'Yiren' and the Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes 'Xuanren'; the translation reads 'Xuanren' (the Song empress dowager Xuanren who was called 'the Yao and Shun among women').
